notes: TBAI does not yet have IG/TikTok accounts. This flow is ready to activate once accounts are created and connected.

flow.trigger: User comments 'PROFIT' (case-insensitive) on any Reel or TikTok

step_1_dm_initial.message: Hey! Saw your comment. Drop me a follow and I'll send the Job Profit Analyzer right over.

step_2_dm_after_follow.message:
Here you go! Enter one job -- revenue, labor hours, wage, materials, subs, equipment -- and it shows the true margin after labor burden, callbacks, and overhead, plus which bucket is eating the profit and the fix.

topbuilderai.com/job-profit

Let me know if you have any questions.

step_2_alt_already_following.trigger: User was already following when they commented
step_2_alt_already_following.message:
Hey! Here's the Job Profit Analyzer -- run one of your jobs through it and see the true margin after labor burden, callbacks, and overhead, plus which bucket is eating the profit.

topbuilderai.com/job-profit

Let me know if you have any questions.
